raw_job_log.retrieval: github_fetch_workflow_job_logs structuredContent.content preserved without edits, including original leading BOM and line endings

budget.scope: Assigned-job runtime excludes queued waiting and is not a full task or learning-amortization cost.

all_job_steps.name: Verify GitHub prospective merge ref matches this exact candidate
Test execution-record rejection and retained diagnostics
Expose DotSlash for existing integration tests
Verify Cargo lock resolution and print exact resolver drift
Inference owner regressions and streaming digest
Module lifecycle generations and migration rollback
Compiled service lifecycle and actual process restart
Retain advisory candidate Git transport observation
Retain exact source input on failure for reproducible diagnosis
Retain command records and bounded stdout stderr

coverage_limits.counting_rule: Each original execution record retains its own observed test count. Do not add counts across filtered commands, overlapping suites, architectures, or prior sources into independent tasks or held-out clusters.
coverage_limits.qualification_scope: Current-source ARM engineering tests for inference, operation/effect recovery, lifecycle and migration, objective/prompt policy, final-use and browser semantics, selection/adoption/rollback, ledger, compiled runtime/process restart, and derived-view consistency.
coverage_limits.not_proved: This does not establish the live ordinary document-to-Notes A/B/C chain, independent B net utility, or RSI. Native adoption tests are engineering controls, not deployed model adoption.
coverage_limits.aggregate_state: The Architecture required fan-in job was still queued when this source-head result was archived; this metadata does not claim aggregate completion.
